newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: PRESS DIGEST - Czech Republic - April 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Czech Republic - April 9.

text.p: HOPSODARSKE NOVINY - During the first three months of this year, consumer prices increased by only 1.6 percent, while in March there was an increase of only 0.1 percent. Year-on-year inflation in March was 6.8 percent and average inflation for the last 12 months fell to 8.4 percent.
- According to Health Minister Jan Strasky, direct payments for patients should increase by 30 percent during the next few years and not by 60 percent as the minister originally proposed.
- Petrochemical company Unipetrol shows interest in obtaining the network of service stations of what remains of Benzina.

- The metalworks Kovohute Bridlicna, against which the Security Centre of the Finance Ministry began administrative action at the beginning of April because of unfulfilled information requirements, aims to enter the Prague Stock Exchange by June.

LIDOVE NOVINY - Members of the Slovak cabinet request that President Vaclav Havel apologise for his remarks made about Slovak Prime Minister Vladimir Meciar in an interview with the French daily Le Figaro.
- Skoda Plzen won the tender for supplying trolleybuses to San Fransisco, a contract worth about five billion crowns.

- The "package" of economic measures, which the cabinet has been discussing during the last few days, will have two parts, according to Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus. These are corrections of short-term economic policies and institutional microeconomic measures.
MLADA FRONTA DNES - The cabinet is considering cutting up to 30 billion crowns from the government budget, postponing an increase in pensions and increasing tariffs on imports.
- Unemployment decreased by 0.2 percent to 3.9 percent last month in comparison to February.
PRAVO - The Czech-Moravian Football League and Domean from IPB Group are taking steps to establish Lotto-Toto, which should operate lottery and betting games in competition with Sazka.

- Since the Prague Stock Exchange began operations on April 6, 1993, it has had trade worth 831.5 billion crowns. On the central market, securities worth 77.1 billion crowns were traded. Last year, 393.199 billion crowns was traded.
- Ceskomoravsky Penzijni Fond, from IPB Group, had net profits of 75 million crowns last year, more than seven times its profits from the previous year.
